column1: # Haptics redundancy matrix (accessibility-test-plan S3). Every critical alert has
# >=2 channels (visual + haptic and/or audio). Procedure: trigger each with the
# vibration motor on/off; haptics-off requires a persistent visual banner;
# display-off requires distinct call (repeating) vs SMS (double-pulse) patterns.
# Motor latency tap-to-buzz <50ms. Result cells: TODO-measured per release.
